text: This headline sizes itself to fill its box, with zero JavaScript. For years we faked this with scripts. Now it's one line of CSS called text-fit, and it shipped in Chrome 150. Set text-fit to grow, and the browser scales the font until the line touches both edges. Resize the box, and the type follows. Set it to shrink, and long titles scale down instead of overflowing. Add a percentage, like grow 300 percent, to cap how far it goes. It's still experimental and Chrome-only, so keep a normal font size as your fallback. Headlines that fit the box, finds that fit your week. Subscribe for the next one.
